title: BioKG-Align v0.4.0 Submission Schema
description: JSON-Schema description of the participant submission TSV for the BioKG-Align main track (ID-joined format). The submission is one tab-separated file covering every task; rows are joined to queries by the opaque QueryID, in any order. Validation tooling: `biokg-align-kit verify` runs the platform's strict loader.

format.description: Format identifier. Not a column in the TSV; included here for tooling that wants to embed the schema reference.

file_layout.description: Per-row structure of the submission TSV.

QueryID.description: Opaque query identifier copied from tasks/<task>/<split>.cands.tsv (e.g. 'SNOMED-FMA-3fa94c0e'). The prefix is the task; the eight hex digits carry no information about the query.

SrcEntity.description: The query's source entity, exactly as in the candidate file.

TgtEntity.description: Target entity identifier; must be a member of that query's candidate set.

Score.description: Finite real-valued confidence score (higher = more confident). Negative values are allowed; NaN and infinity are rejected.

query_layout.description: How submission rows map to queries.

join.const: rows are joined to queries by QueryID; row order is irrelevant
join.description: The scorer never uses row position.

files.const: one file for all tasks of the phase
files.description: A single submission covers every task; the QueryID prefix names the task.

rows_per_query.const: exactly candidate_count x 3: every (candidate, relation) pair of the query, once
rows_per_query.description: Canonical release: 50 candidates x 3 relations = 150 rows per query.

candidate_count.description: Number of candidate target entities per query in the canonical release (release_manifest.json['candidate_count']).

relations_per_query.description: Number of relations scored per (query, candidate) pair.

validation_rules.description: Rules applied by the platform scorer, the organiser's private test scoring and `biokg-align-kit verify` (strict mode, all fatal). The kit's local `score` command for train/valid is lenient by default and reports the same violations as warnings with a documented fallback; see documentation/submission_scoring.md.

const: The header is exactly QueryID, SrcEntity, TgtEntity, Relation, Score (and every row has five fields)
Every QueryID exists in the phase's candidate files, and every query appears
SrcEntity equals the query's source entity
TgtEntity is in the query's candidate set
Relation is one of equivalent, source_subsumed_by_target, source_subsumes_target
Score parses to a finite float
Every query has exactly candidate_count x 3 rows

sizing.description: Expected test-phase file sizes for the canonical v0.4.0 build.

n_queries_canonical.description: Total test queries across all three tasks in the canonical v0.4.0 build.

n_rows_canonical.description: Total test submission rows for the canonical build (n_queries_canonical * 150).
